title: cyperus ovularis var. wolfii
intro: Cyperus ovularis var. wolfii, commonly known as Wolf's Sedge, is a variety of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in various cultures to treat a range of health issues, including fever, respiratory problems, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Wolf's Sedge include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and as a diuretic, aiding in the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus ovularis var. wolfii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
